dct_description_sm: This data package, “ELA LTER Discharge” (DOI: https://doi.org/10.25976/whsn-1u21), is being retired and will no longer be updated. It has been superseded by the new hydrology package (DOI: https://doi.org/10.25976/2f23-gr01), which expands the dataset to include stream temperature and lake level in addition to stream flow (discharge), and covers all currently active IISD-ELA hydrometric stations rather than only Lake 239. Future updates will be made to the *new* hydrology package. At the time of writing, the new package contains data through 2026.
